name: Lens Blur
description: A shallow depth of field after the fact. Lens Blur estimates how far away each part of the photo is and blurs what lies outside the distance you pick, the way a lens would: the foreground spills softly over sharp edges, the background stays behind the subject, and bright points bloom into round, bubble, five-blade, ring or cat-eye bokeh. Pick the focus on the photo or on a depth strip, paint nearer or further where the estimate is wrong, and show the depth over the photo to check it.
author: Anthony Reimche

permissions.reason: Downloads the depth model (Depth Anything V2 Small, about 27 MB) once, the first time you choose Estimate depth.
